department: Department of Chemistry and Applied Biosciences (D-CHAB)

deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open. Bachelor's holders applying for the Direct Doctorate must apply in the Master's window, 1-30 November 2026.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

also.quote: International Bachelor's degrees: 1 - 30 November 2026 | students who wish to apply for the Excellence & Opportunity Scholarship Programme (ESOP) or a Direct doctorate programme (DD)

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: A D-CHAB professor must accept you as a doctoral student; contact professors before applying.
supervisor.quote: Furthermore, a professor of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology has to accept you as a doctoral student. | prospective doctoral students should contact a professor of the Department

funding.value: Apart from a few exceptions, ETH doctoral students are employed (salaried) as scientific assistants.
funding.quote: Apart from a few exceptional cases, all doctoral students at ETH Zurich are employed as scientific assistants.

entry_route.value: A diploma or Master's with excellent grades is normally required; exceptional Bachelor's graduates can apply for the Direct Doctorate in Chemistry or in Chemical and Bioengineering with a professor's written funding confirmation.
entry_route.quote: Admission to a doctoral programme requires that you hold a diploma or a Master's degree with excellent grades.

also.quote: If you are applying for the Direct Doctorate in Chemistry, submit a complete application for the Master's degree programme with the following additions: | A written confirmation of a an ETH Zurich professor for the financing of the Master's degree programme and subsequent doctoral studies in his or her research group
If you are applying for the Direct Doctorate in Chemical and Bioengineering, submit a complete application for the Master's degree programme

notes: D-CHAB covers chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences and chemical/bioengineering (Institute of Chemical and Bioengineering). Salary rates are set per institute.
